title: Trump and Stoltenberg get into tense exchange at NATO summit
summary: A Washington Post clip of President Trump and NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg in a tense exchange at the July 2018 NATO summit, where Trump criticized Germany's reliance on Russian energy.
why: HN cites it as evidence in arguments about European dependence on Russian gas and NATO spending, especially after Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

quote.text: Trump and NATO secretary-general and former Norwegian PM Jens Stoltenberg argue on camera
